name: uz-text
description: Converts Uzbek text between Cyrillic, the 1995 Latin alphabet and the new Latin alphabet (Ö Ğ Ş Ç), writes amounts in Uzbek words for invoices, fixes apostrophe variants, and reads the Central Bank of Uzbekistan's official exchange rates.
